objectives: Therefore, this systematic review and meta-analysis aim to evaluate the influence of RA on stroke risk globally.
inclusion_criteria: We included cohort or cross-sectional studies that examined the association between RA and stroke risk, with clear diagnoses of both conditions.
exclusion_criteria: Studies were excluded if they did not report odds ratios (OR) with corresponding 95% confidence intervals (CI). In cases where multiple studies reported data from the same cohort, we selected the study with the longest follow-up or largest sample size. Conference abstracts, study protocols, and duplicate publications were also excluded.
pmid_query: ((("Stroke"[Mesh]) OR ((((((Stroke*[Title/Abstract]) OR (Cerebrovascular Accident*[Title/Abstract])) OR (Cerebrovascular Apoplexy[Title/Abstract])) OR (Brain Vascular Accident*[Title/Abstract])) OR (Apoplexy[Title/Abstract])) OR (CVAs[Title/Abstract]))) AND (("Arthritis, Rheumatoid"[Mesh]) OR (Rheumatoid Arthritis[Title/Abstract]))) AND (("risk"[Mesh]) OR (risk[Title/Abstract]))
selection_evidence: The main manuscript uses author-year citations rather than numbered references. In Results/Literature search, the paper states that 3,468 records were identified, 15 articles were potentially relevant, and 12 studies were ultimately included: Baviera et al. 2021; Chen et al. 2018a; Chen et al. 2018b; Wolfe, Breundlich/Freundlich & Straus 2003; Kang et al. 2022; Lee et al. 2021; Liou et al. 2014; Logstrup et al. 2021; Shin et al. 2025; Tiosano et al. 2017; Trommer et al. 2021; Zou et al. 2017. The Study characteristics section repeats the same 12-study set and Table 1 lists those same 12 studies with study characteristics. Fig. 2 also names the identical 12 studies. Supplemental PRISMA checklist maps study selection to Fig. 1 and study characteristics to Table 1, and supplemental Table 1 provides the full PubMed search strategy.
notes: Used study_entries because exact numbered references are unavailable in this PeerJ article: the manuscript, Table 1, and reference list are author-year and unnumbered.
